Name: Official Xbox Magazine: Volume 69: April 2007
Overview:
Official Xbox Magazine (OXM) Demo Disc #69 shipped to subscribers in March 2007 (bearing the cover date of April 2007 for Issue 69). Authoring exclusively for the Xbox 360 hardware, Disc #69 packed native high-definition 360 playable demos and Xbox Live Arcade (XLA) trial games:

Command & Conquer 3: Tiberium Wars (real-time strategy)
TMNT (Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles) (arcade action-adventure)
Rayman Raving Rabbids (party minigame collection)
Worms (Xbox Live Arcade turn-based artillery strategy)
Band of Bugs (Xbox Live Arcade tactical strategy)

In addition to interactive gameplay, the native 360 disc included downloadable dashboard media (gamerpics and custom themes), offline backward-compatibility emulation updates, and high-definition 720p/1080i video previews—including early featurettes for Halo 3, Grand Theft Auto IV, Guitar Hero II, and The Darkness, along with OXM's monthly Top Plays segment.
